an4.258:1.1: yāni kāni ci bhikkhave kulāni bhogesu mahantataṃ pattāni na ciraṭṭhitikāni bhavanti, sabbāni tāni catuhi ṭhānehi, etesaṃ vā aññatarena.
an4.258:1.3: naṭṭhaṃ na gavesanti, jiṇṇaṃ na paṭisaṅkharonti, aparimitapānabhojanā honti, dussīlaṃ itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā ādhipacce ṭhapenti.
an4.258:1.4: yāni kāni ci bhikkhave kulāni bhogesu mahantataṃ pattāni. na ciraṭṭhitikāni bhavanti, sabbāni tāni imehi catuhi ṭhānehi, etesaṃ vā aññatarena.
an4.258:2.1: yāni kāni ci bhikkhave kulāni bhogesu mahantataṃ pattāni ciraṭṭhitikāni bhavanti, sabbāni tāni catuhi ṭhānehi, etesaṃ vā aññatarena.
an4.258:2.3: naṭṭhaṃ gavesanti, jiṇṇaṃ paṭisaṅkharonti, parimitapānabhojanā honti, sīlavantaṃ itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā ādhipacce ṭhapenti.
an4.258:2.4: yāni kāni ci bhikkhave kulāni bhogesu mahantataṃ pattāni ciraṭṭhitikāni bhavanti, sabbāni tāni imehi catuhi ṭhānehi, etesaṃ vā aññatarenāti.
